title: Epic head CI red: classify-tick pin stale after 7sn changed closeout profile
body:
Tick 7sn (05ab6c83b) edited profiles/closeout-epic.md, which changes profileSetDigest and therefore provenance.profile_digest in every classification decision record. cloudflare/test/fixtures/classify-tick-decision.json was not regenerated, so TestTheClassificationRecordIsPinnedAsItIsWritten fails on the epic head (CI run 37380024533, headSha 9e924ef811, job 'go test (reconcile 2/3)'; also 37378487207 and 37376277849). The test is EndToEnd, so the per-tick make gate skipped it. Fix: run `go test ./internal/reconcile -run TestTheClassificationRecordIsPinnedAsItIsWritten -update-pin`, read the one-line diff (profile_digest sha256:3b438330... -> sha256:59098f58...), commit it, and then wait for CI on the epic head to be green. Verified locally: after regeneration the reconcile and runstate pin tests pass.
evidence: internal/reconcile/classify_pin_test.go:106; cloudflare/test/fixtures/classify-tick-decision.json provenance.profile_digest; gh run view 37380024533 --log-failed
